description: Defines a template class FixedVector with fixed maximum size and storage, including methods for vector operations, comparison operators, and internal management.

classes.name: FixedVector
classes.description: A fixed-size vector class with maximum capacity N, supporting standard vector operations.

methods.name: push_back
methods.description: Adds an element to the end of the vector.

methods.name: pop_back
methods.description: Removes the last element from the vector.

methods.name: resize
methods.description: Resizes the vector to the specified size.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all elements from the vector.
